builds.name: Frostbite ceiling
builds.summary: Chilled Frostbite doubles its 155 + .55 AP packet, giving 310 + 1.1 AP. AP and MR penetration directly improve this doubled hit.
builds.goal: Chilled Frostbite doubles its 155 + .55 AP packet, giving 310 + 1.1 AP. AP and MR penetration directly improve this doubled hit.
builds.hypothesis:
Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing [55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage. Against Chilled enemies, Anivia deals [(55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.55) × AP) × (2)] magic damage instead.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Shadowflame, Seraph's Embrace, Banshee's Veil, Riftmaker. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.

builds.name: Glacial Storm: four seconds at full size
builds.summary: Investigate high fully grown Glacial Storm over four seconds output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high fully grown Glacial Storm over four seconds output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-3 R initially deals 60 + 0.125 AP magic per second; its fully grown state triples that rate to 180 + 0.375 AP. A four-second fully grown observation has 720 + 1.5 AP nominal damage before actual tick timing and mitigation. Earned Seraph and Deathcap support AP and resource capacity; Riftmaker is a separately prepared damage ramp. Storm size and slow are not extra damage multipliers.

kitEvidence.formula:
Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing [50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage and Chilling enemies for [3] seconds, Slowing them by @Spell.GlacialStorm:SlowAmount@%. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds and dealing [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage.

Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.
